segments.text: 一般来说在合体时，两只数码宝贝的数码核心会完全融合，接着重生为一只新的数码宝贝。然而混沌兽身上却保留了两只数码宝贝合体前的数码核心，并以非常不完全的状态维持着其样貌。混沌兽是「不可能存在」的数码宝贝的代号，在数码世界的“中心原理”中，是绝对不可能的特异（错误）。它是一种极为不稳定的存在，因此寿命非常短，据推测是因为数码世界管理系统启动的排除错误程序不停运作，才导致它寿命缩短。这只混沌兽普遍被认为是由番长狮子兽与暗龙兽合体而诞生的数码宝贝，从其双臂上可分别看见这两只数码宝贝的影子。必杀技是由「番长臂」上装备的「BAN-TYO之剑」所击出的无敌一刀两断『霸王两断剑』，以及从「暗龙臂」上装备的「十亿杀戮加农炮」发射出自身数码细胞的『黑暗阳焰』。

Glen Elg was a skilled computer programmer working for Blue Screens, Inc.

He was killed following problems with repayment arrangements he had with a loan shark, Furio Tigre. Elg had a gambling addiction that led him to borrow $50,000 from Tigre at Tender Lender. Due to the exceedingly large interest rates at Tender Lender, the debt soon doubled to $100,000. Elg agreed to meet Tigre on December 3 at Trés Bien, and to program a powerful computer virus to use as collateral. However, Tigre had a debt of his own that amounted to $1 million. He counted on Elg to be unable to pay his debt and give him the virus, which would fetch several million dollars on the black market.

At the meeting, Elg miraculously won $500,000 in a lottery, which meant that there was no legitimate reason for the virus he brought to be given over. Desperate for the virus to pay off his own debts, Tigre killed him and then set up a fake murder later that was almost identical to the real one in order to manipulate the crime scene and frame Maggey Byrde.
